*F-thdec* (Threshold decryption) is part of *Layer 6: Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Abe and Fehr. *Adaptively secure feldman VSS and applications to universally-composable threshold cryptography*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2004, pages 317–334, 2004.
- Damgård and Nielsen. *Universally composable efficient multiparty computation from threshold homomorphic encryption*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2003, 2003. (citation not independently verified)
